details: Now this is something maybe you should of listened to before pushing a eac update so fast why don't you just add mod support? mods and clints are different adding mod support would allow you to see what mods most people use and look into the mods that have bad intent OR even adding steam workshop support I know not all users are are steam but that would also add for the people that have fps issues anti crashers they'd still be able to use those sense EAC does not prevent crashers I get not wanting clint users in your game but they make up 10% of the community and 80% use mods. Mods and clints are very different and normalizing using mods or steam workshop and you can sill use a anti cheat system in the game and support mods because I understand you cant push the accessibility for color blind deaf people mutes so quickly and there already in forms of mods.  You can have a anti cheat and still support mods. using EAC still supports that even though EAC is not my personal preference there are ways to make the community happy and still use anti cheats, please consider adding moded support instead of shunning features that add so much to the that have no harmful intent. Also adding steam workshop really solv the clint/mod issue i think most would be fbt support or just support for deaf and mut community so you don't feel like you have to constantly push content and sense most of the vrc content is creator based it would allow creators more access aswell and you can always deny or block things on the workshop that don't fit under TOS.
title: EAC and adding mod support
